authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Full kṛṣṇa colour subsection 1 explicitly gives Kalasha kriẓṇa/krīṇḍa, Bshk kiṣin, Torwali kəṣən, Palula kiṣiṇu and Shina Kohistani kiṇŭ black, as well as Prakrit kasiṇa/kiṇha. These support the selected Dardic kṛṣṇa/kīṣan/kino colour responses. Survey rhotic retention/loss, vowel quality, sibilant notation, nasalization and inflection remain unchanged and their local phonetic history is qualified. This is colour-family membership, not a link to the proper-name subsection; uncertain cross-IA transmission remains explicit. Exact response: kirīśna.
